skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept, characteristics, and investment tools in financial markets.
Differentiate between fundamental and technical analysis, and apply these methods to investment analysis.
Understand the reasons for using valuation methods for financial instruments and apply these methods to bonds and stocks.
Construct and manage an effective financial investment portfolio based on modern theories.
Apply economic principles, probability, and statistics to investment analysis.
Develop independent analytical skills and group work abilities in applying investment analysis methods.
Enhance self-directed learning and research skills to improve the effectiveness of investment analysis and portfolio selection.
Develop skills in organizing group discussions, working independently, and presenting on investment finance topics.
Demonstrate a sense of discipline in class, cooperation, and responsibility in group activities, and form personal opinions on practical investment analysis issues.
